title: Out-of-bounds read can crash git-apply(1) when binary patch inflates to very large size (CVE-2026-114469)
description: A vulnerability in git-apply(1) allows an out-of-bounds read that can crash the process when a binary patch inflates to a very large size. This flaw is identified as CVE-2026-114469 and has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.4. The issue does not have any known exploits in the wild and no specific affected versions or patches have been provided.
